mitigations.action_text: Halted drilling immediately. Spotted 60 bbl high-fluid-loss squeeze LCM pill with coarse calcium carbonate and mica flakes.
mitigations.outcome: Well stabilized after 14 hrs. Mud losses reduced to zero seepage. Resumed drilling with adjusted ECD.

mitigations.action_text: Mixed and spotted 50 bbl oil-based lubricating freeing pill around BHA. Worked drillstring with maximum allowable torque and jarred downward.
mitigations.outcome: Pipe freed after 9.5 hours of jarring. Reamed interval with increased PAC-R polymer concentration.

mitigations.action_text: Pulled string 4 stands off bottom. Pumped dual-density fibrous LCM blend and reduced circulation rate to 350 gpm.
mitigations.outcome: Loss zone sealed successfully. Non-productive time limited to 11 hours.
